title: console: shell menu navigations (Help, avatar Profile / Organizations, workspace switcher, sidebar Design) leave a dirty settings page without asking — an organization switch escapes even the browser's leave prompt
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named site, measured at a public entry.** Follow-up owed by the landed objectui#13163 (PR #13204, whose `useUnsavedLeaveGuard` doc names the gap). Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectui#5560, `session_014MXhk1yjWh37d634hLy3p7`) from a read-only census it ran to measure a finding booked on a landed card. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat. The sites are in `@object-ui/app-shell`'s shell.

## The defect
A settings page with unsaved edits asks before a link, its own crumb, or a tab close takes them away (objectui#13163). But the shell's menu entries navigate with `navigate()` from a button, so they leave the page with no question and the edit is lost. An organization switch escapes even the browser's leave prompt.

**Measured** in Chromium 141 on the real console (objectui `main` `5c12dcd`), with the API stubbed for an admin with two organizations, on `/apps/crm/system/settings/localization` with one unsaved change.

**Controls, guarded:** the sidebar link, the "All settings" crumb, the app switcher's "All apps", and a full document load each asked, and Cancel kept the edit.

**Bypasses, no question, edit lost:**
- Help > "All documentation" (`AppHeader.tsx:1146`);
- avatar > "Profile" (`:1224`), "My Organizations" (`:1250`) and "Create organization" (`:1260`);
- WorkspaceSwitcher > "Manage members" (`WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx:135`) and "Create organization" (`:144`);
- sidebar item ⋯ > "Design" (`SidebarItemMenu.tsx:365`);
- **WorkspaceSwitcher > another organization** (`:125`, `handleSwitch` `:81`–`:89`). `set-active` is sent first, then `window.location.href`. The guard's `beforeunload` listener is removed about 150 ms after `set-active` answers, so no prompt appears. The organization has switched before anything could ask.

The same shape, read from source and not measured: `AppHeader.tsx:1134`–`:1139`, `:1284`, `:1330` (sign-out), and `:390` (go-home shortcut). `ResourceEditPage.tsx:2171` has the same anchor-only guard.

## reach
Public entry measured once: a dirty settings page in the real console shell. The header and switcher entries appear for every signed-in user, and the switcher appears with two or more organizations.

## Expected
Every shell-initiated departure from a page that holds unsaved edits asks first, the same question the anchor guard asks. That needs a shell-level "this page holds unsaved edits" seam that `navigate()` callers consult, rather than another anchor listener. An organization switch asks before `set-active` is sent.

## Dedupe
Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed.
- "unsaved changes leave guard bypassed by navigate from menu button": 4 hits. Only objectui#13163 (closed, the parent, which names this residual as unmeasured) is on point; objectui#11950, #11189 and #11203 are unrelated.
- "settings page edits lost without confirm when switching organization or opening profile from header": 2 hits, objectui#13163 and #12698 (unrelated).

**New.** Dedupe words: leave guard navigate button; shell menu unsaved changes; organization switch drops edits; useUnsavedLeaveGuard seam.
